# The Four Emperors

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-6aac279f3235707b"></a>

## The Four Emperors

Four pirates rule the New World. Their names keep the Marines awake and their flags keep whole islands safe.

Land on a town island in the New World.

The Four Emperors are the four Pirates with the highest bounties over 1,000,000 (Haki Realm's faction seats, /haki faction).

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Supernova](f_pirates.md#q-1dfc50f05e0088a4)

**Tasks**

- Land on a town island in the New World

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500, Bounty +2,000,000

<a id="q-40a06311e9a585b5"></a>

## Under an Emperor's Flag

Whitebeard called his crew his sons. Big Mom's crew is her family. Kaido's answers to strength alone.

Sail in the crew of one of the Four Emperors, or be one.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Four Emperors](f_emperors.md#q-6aac279f3235707b)

**Tasks**

- Sail in an Emperor's crew (or be an Emperor)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +80,000, Bounty +5,000,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku

<a id="q-784c9c9892483f60"></a>

## Emperor

An Emperor's word is law across a quarter of the New World, and the World Government counts them as a power of their own.

Hold one of the Four Emperors' seats as the captain of your crew.

Reward for the captain: an Emperor's fruit while nobody has it (Gomu Gomu, Yami Yami, Soru Soru, Uo Uo Model: Seiryu, Gura Gura), or a Golden Box, picked from a chat menu (/fruitreward).

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Under an Emperor's Flag](f_emperors.md#q-40a06311e9a585b5)

**Tasks**

- Hold an Emperor's seat as your crew's captain

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +300,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style)
- Choose an Emperor's fruit: Gomu, Yami, Soru, Seiryu or Gura, or a Golden Box (captain only)
